title: Primary Blight
summary: Primary Blight is an Arcane Enhancement for Primary Weapons that provides Critical Damage and Multishot when the equipped weapon applies a  Toxin status effect.
extract:
Primary Blight is an Arcane Enhancement for Primary Weapons that provides Critical Damage and Multishot when the equipped weapon applies a  Toxin status effect.

Effect

Acquisition
May be sold by Acrithis for 10  Pathos Clamp on a daily rotational basis, requiring Drifter Intrinsics Opportunity Rank 9 for the arcanes to appear in her shop.
This Arcane can be acquired from Duviri's Circuit Steel Path, or random rewards from Undercroft optional portals.
Possible reward from Deepmines Bounties from Nightcap.
Purchaseable from Nightcap in Fortuna for 10  Fergolyte each, with a total of 210 for max rank.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
At all ranks, it will take 40   Toxin procs to reach the maximum bonus.
Unlike all other weapon arcanes that trigger from status effects, stacking the Blight buff requires the  Toxin proc to be inflicted by using the attached primary weapon.
Effects that add  Toxin element to the primary weapon, such as  Saryn's  Toxic Lash and  Oraxia's  Silken Stride can modify the elemental makeup of the weapon's damage, but casting an ability cannot stack the Blight buff.
Secondary weapons, Melee weapons, and abilities and weapons used by Companions are also not capable of triggering the Blight buff.
Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as Bosses and Adversaries, applying a  Toxin proc to an enemy at max procs will still cause Primary Blight to refresh and stack.
Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply  Toxin.
If the 12 second timer expires without applying a fresh  Toxin status effect, all stacks are removed.
This behavior is consistent with other weapon arcanes that trigger on status effect application, like  Primary Frostbite and  Cascadia Flare.
This is distinct from weapon arcanes that trigger on kill, like  Primary Merciless and  Primary Deadhead, where timer expiration causes only one stack to be removed at a time.
 Primary Frostbite, a primary weapon arcane with similar effects except triggered by  Cold, can be compared to Blight, and both weapon arcanes yield very effective damage boosts with only slight differences.
 Primary Blight, triggering from  Toxin, offers a maximum 144% Critical Damage and 72% Multishot, prioritizing Critical Damage.
 Primary Frostbite, triggering on  Cold, offers a maximum 120% Critical Damage and 90% Multishot, prioritizing Multishot.
However,  Primary Frostbite has advantages over  Primary Blight, since the Frostbite buff can be stacked with  Cold status effects from any source, whereas  Primary Blight can only be stacked from primary weapon  Toxin status effects.
